reviews.text: Everyone there is always sweet and easy with my old scared doggie.   He was badly abused before I adopted him so he definitely has trust issues.  Staff here are gentle with him and that’s everything to me.

Our current vet couldn't see our dog the same day. I remembered a friend told us about Acres North. I called and they saw her within an hour. Even though we got there 30 minutes before they closed Dr. Tiedeman spent quality time with us and explained everything thoroughly. It looks like we will have a new vet now. 100% recommend.
Very positive vibe, with knowledge to back it up. Felt assured in the care my lil buddy Dookie was given.
Everyone at Acres North is so caring and helpful.  The vets are the best and always responsive to my needs and my dogs need
The attention is excellent, they are very good with your pets and they explain everything to you, super recommended!!

I would avoid this clinic. They are very rude and they ignore owners. I went twice for my cat's illness. The first visit I was discouraged from pursing diagnostics and told to just bring a fecal sample in. My cat was still sick and I went for a recheck about 2 weeks later. At this visit the tech was very unwelcoming. I told her exactly how to handle my cat for a blood draw and what she will absolutely not tolerate. I requested for the blood to be drawn in the room bc between the techs attitude and the previous visit I realized I did not trust this clinic at the point to do what was best for my animal. They completely proved me right. Another tech came in to draw the blood and the immediately did exactly what I told them would not work. I was so taken back I didn't know what to do. The tech that was drawing blood was extremely rude and was DIGGING in the cat's leg for a vein. She also had a much to large syringe for this to work. I was in shock how unprofessional these people are. The sample they received was clotted due to improper technique and improper materials used. The techs wanted to try again, but they weren't discussing it with me. They were talking to each other, completely ignoring me saying no. I firmly said no this visit is done, paid and left. I did request a refund and it was given, the manager stated I was the first client in 1.5 years that she had to deal with who was upset. I find that hard to believe. When I read my cat's medical notes from them they placed all the blame on me being "frustrated" and took no responsibility for the ineptitude of their staff. Again, I would avoid at all cost.
They always take great care of my dogs!
My puppy dog had to have an enucleation done which is removal of the eye. The staff was amazing, Dr.papas was very informative. Really appreciate the empathy and care from the staff.

Wonderful place, friendly staff. Would definitely recommend.

I called to get an idea on pricing and ended up setting an appointment for the next day. Their reasonable pricing and friendly staff made it easier than expected and are now my go to vet!

I had my first visit with Acres North Animal Clinic, and I couldn’t be more pleased with the experience. From the moment I walked in, the entire staff was friendly, welcoming, and professional.

Dr. Pappas had wonderful bedside manner with my cat. They were gentle, patient, and took the time to make my cat feel as comfortable as possible. I especially appreciated that I never felt rushed. The doctor listened carefully to my concerns, answered all of my questions, and explained everything thoroughly.

The entire visit was calm, compassionate, and professional from start to finish. It’s such a relief to find a veterinary team that truly cares about both their patients and their owners. I left feeling confident that my cat received excellent care, and I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a caring and knowledgeable veterinarian,
Dr. Pappas!!!

The vet assistant stayed with me and helped me find the best pharmacy for our prescription. What I liked the most was that they did everything in the room with me there and not once did they even suggest to muzzle my dog. Our last vet did both those things and it made me very uncomfortable. I’ve already recommended this vet to two friends!

We have had nothing but a FANTASTIC experience with Acres North and their staff! They have been kind, thorough, encouraging, and truly care about our 13 breed, 13 year-old dog:)  They take their time explaining everything to you and Dr. Pappas has called with updates after testing and has truly helped us understand the full picture of our dog's health.  They even sent us a thank you card after our first visit and call to check on him after visits. They have a beautiful facility and are always so cheerful on the phone and in person and all of this means so much to us. We feel SO grateful to have found them!

This is the only Veterinary Clinic where I will ever take my pets.   Heartbroken that I had to put my little dog to sleep today because he was so ill with no cure but everyone was so kind, compassionate, took time to listen, explained every detail, and extremely professional.   Every question answered, every worry understood, and every thought responded to with care.   I have never been to a place so profoundly caring and respectful.

I got her lab work done and then we scheduled her for surgery the next week. Drop off and pick up were super easy (and they ALWAYS get me into a room right away which is appreciated with an older, skittish, reactive dog). My baby came home and is healing quite well. They were so responsive with all of my requests and questions before and after the surgery and I can tell they treated my baby well because she wasn’t terrified to be there and was happy to see all of the technicians.

Dr. Tiedeman is such a kind, caring and gentle veterinarian. The entire staff, from front office to the technicians to our doctor, did so much to help ease anxiety and worries and treat my girl with a ton of care.

I can’t thank or recommend them enough. 💗

🌟 Outstanding First Visit – Gigi and I Felt Truly Cared For 🐾💖

Review:
I had an amazing first experience at Acres North Veterinary Hospital with my teacup Yorkie puppy, Gigi. From the moment we walked in, everyone was incredibly welcoming, patient, and sweet with her.

Alicia, our technician, was so gentle and kind — she made Gigi feel calm and secure. Dr. Laine Tiedeman was wonderful! She explained everything clearly and took the time to answer all my questions as a first-time puppy mom. Her calm and loving approach made me feel confident and reassured.

Kacie and Linda at the front desk were also lovely — friendly, warm, and caring throughout the whole process. It truly felt like we were surrounded by people who love what they do and care deeply for animals.

The clinic is clean, organized, and filled with positive energy. Gigi and I are so happy to have found a vet team we can trust. I highly recommend Acres North to any pet parent looking for compassionate and professional care. 🐶💕

UPDATE
08/04/2025
We came back to Acres North today — this time for little Alice’s first visit! 💜💜

From the moment we walked in, Linda, Lily, and Sarah at the front desk welcomed us with such warmth and smiles. Gigi came along just to support her baby sister, but they still treated her like a queen! 👑🐶 Not only did both pups get treats (which they loved, of course 😋), but the team even weighed Gigi just to update her chart — even though she wasn’t scheduled. That little detail alone says so much about the care they give!

Dr. Tiedeman and Alicia were absolutely lovely — kind, patient, and playful. We all shared a laugh when someone pointed out that Alice and Dr. Tiedeman have matching curly hairstyles! 🐩👩‍⚕️ It was such a fun moment, and honestly, it’s true! 😄

Everyone went above and beyond, treating both girls with love and making sure we felt valued and at ease too. You can really tell this team loves what they do. It wasn’t just a vet visit — it was a feel-good experience from start to finish.

Thank you, Acres North, for being so sweet, attentive, and caring — every single time. We’re truly grateful to have found you.

– Gigi & Alice’s mom 💕

Overpriced for the Quality of Care

I brought my dog here for an ear wound that became infected because he wouldn’t allow me to clean it properly at home. While the staff was friendly, accommodating a same day appointment, and the clinic itself is spotless and modern, the actual care and value for the price left a lot to be desired.

Despite being professionals, the staff told me they could only clean the wound "as much as he would let us," which is exactly the problem I came in with. I was still charged $79 for a "clip and clean" and $46 for an "ear flush" that didn’t fully happen. They prescribed multiple medications: $26.60 for ear drops, $82.04 for eye drops, and two oral medications totaling $83.88. But here's the kicker.... they couldn’t administer the drops or even show me how to because my dog wouldn’t let them, which again, is why I sought professional help in the first place. Now I'm left with over $100 in meds I may not even be able to use.

They also advertise $25 off your first visit, but upon mentioning it they tell me only if it’s a basic check-up. Realistically, how many people go in for their first visit just for a routine check-up? It's misleading. Lastly, they tacked on a $12.50 OSHA compliance fee. Why am I paying for your business to meet basic safety standards? That should be your responsibility, not your customers.

My total bill came out to $528.02, and all I actually received and can use are the two oral medications, which I can only hope for and pray will be enough.

Overall, I felt like I paid a premium price for subpar results. I wouldn’t return here unless there were no other options available. I added a before and after picture of their performed service so you can see what kind and quality  of care they provide.

**Update 5/8/25 (48 hours after initial visit)**
The clinic called me today to check on my dog and see how he was doing. I really appreciate that gesture. I also want to clarify that I don’t have anything against the clinic itself or the people working there. They seem to be extremely nice and accommodating. My issue is strictly with the pricing in relation to the service received. The bottom line is: the service is decent and acceptable, I just don’t feel it matches the high cost. I agreed to the high cost because I assumed the outcome to be of higher completion and quality. So again nothing wrong with the place other than premium pricing for extremely nice interactions from employees and basic mediocre quality of services provided.
